name: Service visit work packet
summary: Before a planned visit to a turbine, inverter or terminal asset, the maintenance supervisor gets one packet built from the logs and approved scope supplied: reported symptoms, previous visits, open parts requests and access questions. It judges no condition and sends nothing.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of field work preparation in energy: the packet a maintenance supervisor reads before a planned visit, and the rule that condition reports no one has verified and missing technical instructions go back to the responsible specialist.
